This classic men's top coat is made from 100% Vicuna fiber, the finest, softest and lightest natural fiber in the world. It is extremely soft, yet warm and the ultimate in luxury outerwear.

title: Handwoven 100% Vicuña Blanket

shipping.summary: Desde EE. UU.; internacional desde US$ 39, aranceles no incluidos

rawDescription:
The Handwoven 100% Vicuña blanket represents one of the rarest expressions of Andean luxury. Only one piece is currently available in Peru , with no confirmed new production date due to the limited availability of vicuña fiber.
Each blanket begins with fiber that is carefully cleaned by hand, strand by strand, before being hand-spun using the traditional pushka spindle. The resulting yarn carries the subtle natural variations that make each piece truly unique. It is then woven and finished by master artisans with decades of experience working with noble fibers, creating a blanket with exceptional softness, warmth, and unmistakable handmade character.
Dimensions: 71 x 35 inches / 31.75  ounces
Vicuna is the finest animal fiber in the world. It is extremely light, amazingly soft, and provides unrivaled warmth. Vicunas may only be sheared every two years and produce a small amount of fiber, increasing the rarity of this beautiful product. In Inca times, only royalty could wear such amazing fiber.

title: The Huascarán Jacket — Black
rawDescription: Innovation often comes from the places you'd least expect, and that's the story of The Huascarán – a sustainable puffer jacket built from two unlikely materials. The shell and lining use Pertex® fabrics with NetPlus® recycled nylon, made from discarded fishing nets off the coast of South America, giving you lightweight and packable protection while helping reduce ocean plastic pollution. Our patented PAKAFILL® insulation blends ethical alpaca fiber with recycled polyester for warmth without bulk. This retro-mountaineering-inspired jacket has angled front pockets that sit clear of your harness, with an interior chest and mesh glove pockets that hold what you actually use. Adjustable cuffs and a bottom hem cinch system seal out the cold, and a 2-way zipper lets you adapt as conditions change. The uniquely woven face fabric repels rain and snow, and a 2-way zipper lets you adapt as conditions change, whether you're climbing, skiing or commuting.

rawDescription: Our lightest PAKAFILL® outerwear yet with a weight-to-warmth ratio rivaling any competitor, the versatile Mayu Ultralight Collection brings easy and uncompromising warmth to all your travel and adventure plans.
